findings.current: My muttered question made no sense even to me, and the tears that had welled in my eyes from sheer disbelief vanished.
findings.defect: The draft invents the idea that Taekyung’s own question made no sense to him. The source says he was so dumbfounded that his tears immediately dried up.
findings.rationale: 어이가 없어서 describes Taekyung’s incredulous reaction to Jeok Cheongang, not a judgment that his own words were nonsensical.
findings.replacement: Utterly dumbfounded, I muttered under my breath, my tears drying up at once.
findings.source: 어이가 없어서 눈물이 쏙 들어간 내 중얼거림에,

findings.current: Did he bake a train whistle in an air fryer?
findings.defect: The draft omits the action of eating the train smokestack, weakening the absurd explanation for Jeok Cheongang’s extraordinary volume.
findings.rationale: 구워 드셨나 explicitly combines roasting with the honorific form of eating; 화통 is the smokestack or firebox rather than the whistle itself.
findings.replacement: Did he roast and eat a train smokestack in an air fryer?
findings.source: 기차 화통을 에어 프라이어에 구워 드셨나.

findings.current: It was a good thing Mungyeong had been spreading a qi barrier since earlier to prevent the sound from escaping. Otherwise, people would have gathered around us long ago.
findings.defect: The draft omits that Mungyeong is using his internal energy to maintain the sound-blocking barrier, losing an explicit mechanical explanation.
findings.rationale: 공력으로 explicitly identifies internal energy as the means by which Mungyeong creates and maintains the barrier.
findings.replacement: It was a good thing Mungyeong had been using his internal energy to maintain a qi barrier and keep any sound from escaping. Otherwise, people would have gathered around us long ago.
findings.source: 아까부터 문경이 공력으로 기막(氣腸)을 펼쳐 소리가 새어 나가는 것을 막고 있어서 망정이지, 아니었다면 진작 사람들이 몰려오고도 남았다.

findings.current: …Well, judging by what he said, I suppose it might have been him.
findings.defect: The pronouns make the dream swordsman the apparent source of the identification. In context, 저쪽 points to Mungyeong: Taekyung is saying it might have been Lü Dongbin based on Mungyeong’s account.
findings.rationale: 저쪽 refers deictically to Mungyeong, preserving that Taekyung is relying on Mungyeong’s proposed identification rather than claiming the swordsman identified himself.
findings.replacement: …Well, judging by what that guy over there said, it might have been.
findings.source: ……뭐, 저쪽 말을 들어 보면 그런 것 같기도 하고.

findings.defect: The draft loses the concrete concern about leaving Mungyeong behind in the current situation.
findings.rationale: 가도 되나 specifically asks whether it is all right for Taekyung to go, which motivates his glance back at Mungyeong.
findings.replacement: Can I really just leave like this?

findings.current: I had no intention of getting caught up in this mess and drifting all the way to Hubei with the fish. I wasn’t some princess of the Yangtze.
findings.defect: The draft omits the mermaid element of the punchline, breaking the connection between the princess joke and drifting downriver with the fish.
findings.rationale: 인어공주 is specifically the Mermaid Princess, and 잘못 걸렸다가 means getting on the wrong side of the dangerous person under discussion rather than merely becoming involved in a generic mess.
findings.replacement: I wasn’t some Mermaid Princess of the Yangtze, and I had absolutely no intention of getting on his bad side and drifting all the way to Hubei with the fish.
findings.source: 무슨 장강의 인어공주도 아니고, 괜히 잘못 걸렸다가 물고기들과 함께 호북까지 떠내려갈 생각은 추호도 없으니까.

findings.current: A man who calls himself the Seafaring King wouldn’t give his Disciple ordinary liquor, would he? Thanks to him, this old man’s tongue is enjoying a rare treat.
findings.defect: The draft changes an acknowledgment of the Seafaring King’s stature into skepticism that he merely calls himself by that title.
findings.rationale: 해상왕씩이나 되는 인간 means someone of the Seafaring King’s standing; it does not question the legitimacy of his title.
findings.replacement: A man as eminent as the Seafaring King wouldn’t have given his Disciple ordinary liquor… Thanks to him, this old man’s tongue is enjoying a rare treat.
findings.source: 해상왕(海上王)씩이나 되는 인간이 제자에게 평범한 술을 선물했을 리는 없고…… 덕분에 모처럼 노부의 혀가 호강하는 거지.

findings.current: That still makes me better than an old man who runs around like a reckless naked thunderbolt despite his age.
findings.defect: 천둥벌거숭이 is mistranslated literally as “naked thunderbolt,” producing a nonexistent image instead of an insult meaning a rash, immature young hothead.
findings.rationale: The idiom characterizes Jeok Cheongang as behaving with the wild immaturity of a heedless youngster, reinforced by 나잇값도 못 하는.
findings.replacement: That still makes me better than an old man who carries on like a reckless brat at his age.
findings.source: 그 나이에도 천둥벌거숭이처럼 날뛰는, 나잇값도 못 하는 늙은이보다는 낫지.

findings.current: In Mungyeong’s estimation, this was impossible without demonic, heterodox arts—and among those, an ancient demonic martial art.
findings.defect: The draft renders 천고의 as merely “ancient” and leaves the English construction grammatically incomplete. The source stresses an extraordinary, legendary demonic art among the heterodox arts.
findings.rationale: 천고의 emphasizes the exceptional, legendary caliber of the suspected demonic martial art, not simply its age.
findings.replacement: In Mungyeong’s estimation, this could only be the work of demonic, heterodox arts—and a legendary demonic martial art at that.
findings.source: 문경이 생각하기에 이것은 사마외도(邪魔外道). 그중에서도 천고의 마공이 아니고서야 불가능한 일이었다.

summary: Several actionable fidelity issues alter a reaction, omit an internal-energy mechanism, misassign a referent, weaken jokes, and mistranslate two characterizing descriptions.
